flores_passage_en: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system. Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece. There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.

Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.

mc_answer2_en: Private cars
mc_answer3_en: A stable biosphere
mc_answer4_en: Human evolution

But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

flores_passage_en: "Leonov, also known as ""cosmonaut No. 11"", was part of the Soviet Union's original team of cosmonauts. On March 18, 1965, he performed the first manned extravehicular activity (EVA), or ""spacewalk"", remaining alone outside the spacecraft for just over twelve minutes. He received the ""Hero of the Soviet Union"", the Soviet Union's highest honor, for his work. Ten years later, he led the Soviet part of the Apollo–Soyuz mission symbolizing that the Space Race was over."

mc_answer2_en: Space Race
mc_answer3_en: Extravehicular activity
mc_answer4_en: Cosmonaut No. 11

flores_passage_en: "Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns. Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices. Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called ""non-serious."" The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report ""truly regrettable."""

flores_passage_en: This is believed to be the fifth time in history that people have observed what turned out to be chemically confirmed martian material falling to Earth. Out of the approximately 24,000 known meteorites to have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been verified to be martian in origin. Fifteen of these rocks are attributed to the meteorite shower last July. Some of the rocks, which are very rare on Earth, are being sold from US$11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is about ten times more than the cost of gold.

flores_passage_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand. Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years. We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past. Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events. You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
question_en: Which should be noted about a cyclical event in order to track the passing of time?
mc_answer1_en: Duration
mc_answer2_en: Repetition
mc_answer3_en: Affect
mc_answer4_en: Difficulty

flores_passage_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria. They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea. Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.
question_en: What does the Italian term ‘Cinque Terre’ refer to?
mc_answer1_en: Five villages
mc_answer2_en: Five paths
mc_answer3_en: Five cliffs
mc_answer4_en: Five seas
flores_passage: Cinque Terre, যাৰ অৰ্থ পাঁচখন ভূমি, ইটালীৰ লিগুৰিয়া অঞ্চলত অৱস্থিত পাঁচখন সৰু উপকূলীয় গাঁও Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza আৰু Monterosso ৰ অন্তৰ্ভুক্ত। এওঁলোক ইউনেস্কোৰ বিশ্ব ঐতিহ্য তালিকাত অন্তৰ্ভুক্ত হৈ আছে। শতাব্দীজুৰি, মানুহে সাগৰক আওকাণ কৰা খাড়া, খাড়া ভূ-পৃষ্ঠত সতৰ্কতাৰে টেৰাছ নিৰ্মাণ কৰিছে। ইয়াৰ আকৰ্ষণৰ এটা অংশ হৈছে দৃশ্যমান কৰ্পৰেট বিকাশৰ অভাৱ। পথ, ৰে'ল আৰু নাৱে গাঁওসমূহক সংযোগ কৰে, আৰু গাড়ীবোৰ বাহিৰৰ পৰা তেওঁলোকৰ ওচৰলৈ যাব নোৱাৰে।

flores_passage_en: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation. It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude. The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species. Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species

flores_passage_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world. flores_passage_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings. An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites. A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person. Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases. flores_passage_en: """Panama Papers"" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016. The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations. British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this. There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned."

flores_passage_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain. Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak. But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel. However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.
question_en: Operation Sealion was an invasion of which country?
mc_answer1_en: Germany
mc_answer2_en: Britain
mc_answer3_en: France
mc_answer4_en: Poland

flores_passage_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution. The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information. The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong. This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures. People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

flores_passage_en: "Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal. In an interview, he said the new variant was ""very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."" Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers. In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts. However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa."
question_en: How many patients that contracted the new variant were confirmed to be healthcare workers?

flores_passage_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence. Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall. flores_passage_en: "After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap. Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as ""Dunlap broadsides"". The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8. One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10. The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived."

flores_passage_en: "If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence. However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map. Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words ""Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776"". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down. While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage. So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label."
question_en: How are the words on the back of the Declaration of Independence written?

mc_answer3_en: Upside down

flores_passage_en: "In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver. He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries. His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few ""household names"" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone. His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent ""Great Deeds by Swedish Kings"" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records. He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills."

flores_passage_en: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast. The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park. The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain. The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas. Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
question_en: Which part of the forest lies within Indian territory?
mc_answer1_en: Sundarbans National Park
mc_answer2_en: The wildlife sanctuary
mc_answer3_en: The World Heritage Site
mc_answer4_en: The Gangetic plain
flores_passage: সুন্দৰবন হ'ল বিশ্বৰ সৰ্ববৃহৎ উপকূলীয় মংগৰুৱ বেল্ট, যি উপকূলৰ পৰা ৮০ কিলোমিটাৰ (৫০ মাইল) বাংলাদেশী আৰু ভাৰতীয় অন্তৰ্দেশলৈ প্ৰসাৰিত হয়। সুন্দৰবনক ইউনেস্ক'ৰ বিশ্ব ঐতিহ্য ক্ষেত্ৰ হিচাপে ঘোষণা কৰা হৈছে। ভাৰতৰ ভূখণ্ডৰ ভিতৰত থকা অৰণ্যৰ অংশক সুন্দৰবন ৰাষ্ট্ৰীয় উদ্যান বুলি কোৱা হয়। অৰণ্যবোৰ কেৱল মংগৰুৱ জলাভূমি নহয় যদিও  তাৰে ভিতৰত কেইটামান শক্তিশালী জংঘলৰ অন্তিম অৱশিষ্ট স্তম্ভও আছে যিয়ে এবাৰ গংগা সমভূমি আৱৰিছিল। সুন্দৰবন ৩,৮৫০ কিলোমিটাৰ এলেকা জুৰি আছে, যাৰ প্ৰায় এক তৃতীয়াংশ পানী / জলাভূমি এলেকাত আৱৰি আছে। ১৯৬৬ চনৰ পৰা সুন্দৰবন বন্যপ্ৰাণী অভয়াৰণ্য হৈ আহিছে, আৰু অনুমান কৰা হৈছে যে এতিয়া এই অঞ্চলত ৪০০ ৰয়েল বেংগল বাঘৰ আৰু প্ৰায় ৩০,০০০ দাগযুক্ত হৰিণা আছে।

flores_passage_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo. The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE. Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

flores_passage: ডমিনিকান গণৰাজ্য (ইংৰাজীঃ Dominican Republic, স্পেনিছঃ República Dominicana) হ'ল এক কেৰিবিয়ান দেশ যি হিস্পানিওলা দ্বীপৰ পূব অৰ্ধেক অংশ দখল কৰে, যি হাইটিৰ সৈতে ভাগ কৰে। বগা বালিৰ সৈকত আৰু পৰ্বতীয়া ভূদৃশ্যৰ উপৰিও, এই দেশখন আমেৰিকা মহাদেশৰ আটাইতকৈ পুৰণি ইউৰোপীয় চহৰৰ বাসস্থান, এতিয়া ছেন্টো ডোমিংগোৰ অংশ। দ্বীপটোত প্ৰথমে টাইনো আৰু কেৰিবসকলে বাস কৰিছিল। কেৰিবসকল এৰাৱাকান-ভাষী লোক আছিল যি প্ৰায় ১০,০০০ খ্ৰীষ্টপূৰ্বাব্দত উপস্থিত হৈছিল। ইউৰোপীয় অভিযন্তাৰ আগমনৰ কেইটামান বছৰৰ ভিতৰতে, টাইনোছৰ জনসংখ্যা স্পেনিছ বিজয়ীসকলে যথেষ্ট হ্ৰাস কৰিছিল। ফ্ৰে বাৰ্টলোমে দে লাছ কেছাছ (ট্ৰেটাডো দে লাছ ইণ্ডিয়াছ) ৰ ভিত্তিত ১৪৯২ আৰু ১৪৯৮ চনৰ ভিতৰত স্পেনিছ বিজয়ীসকলে প্ৰায় ১০,০০০ টাইনোছক হত্যা কৰিছিল।

flores_passage_en: "The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood. Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories. Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library. John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said ""Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."" It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series."

flores_passage_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas. The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society. However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture. There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand. They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

flores_passage: ঊনবিংশ আৰু বিংশ শতিকাৰ দীৰ্ঘ সময় ধৰি, নিউজিলেণ্ডৰ প্ৰথম বাসিন্দাসকল মাওৰি লোক আছিল বুলি বিশ্বাস কৰা হৈছিল, যিসকলে মোয়াছ নামৰ বিশাল চৰাই চিকাৰ কৰিছিল। তত্ত্বটোৱে তেতিয়া এই ধাৰণাটো প্ৰতিষ্ঠা কৰিছিল যে মাওৰি লোকসকলে পলিনেশিয়াৰ পৰা এখন ডাঙৰ নৌসেনাত প্ৰব্ৰজন কৰিছিল আৰু মৰিৰিৰ পৰা নিউজিলেণ্ড লৈছিল, এক কৃষি সমাজ স্থাপন কৰিছিল। অৱশ্যে, নতুন প্ৰমাণে পৰামৰ্শ দিয়ে যে মৰিৰিৰি মূল ভূমি মাওৰিৰ এটা গোট আছিল যিসকলে নিউজিলেণ্ডৰ পৰা চাটহাম দ্বীপপুঞ্জলৈ প্ৰব্ৰজন কৰিছিল, তেওঁলোকৰ নিজস্ব স্বতন্ত্ৰ, শান্তিপূৰ্ণ সংস্কৃতি বিকাশ কৰিছিল। চাটহাম দ্বীপপুঞ্জত আন এটা জনজাতিও আছিল যিসকল মাওৰি আছিল যিসকলে নিউজিলেণ্ডৰ পৰা প্ৰব্ৰজন কৰিছিল। তেওঁলোকে নিজকে মৰিৰি বুলি কৈছিল। তাত কেইটামান সংঘৰ্ষ হৈছিল আৰু শেষত মৰিৰিসকলক নিঃশেষ কৰা হৈছিল।

flores_passage_en: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope. After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll. French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings. Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters. Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.

mc_answer1_en: On a voting roll
mc_answer2_en: On a pre-printed sheet of paper
mc_answer3_en: On an envelope
mc_answer4_en: On a machine inside a booth

flores_passage_en: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran. Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins. Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.

mc_answer1_en: They provided access to meat
mc_answer2_en: They helped graze the land
mc_answer3_en: They offered companionship
mc_answer4_en: They provided access to milk

flores_passage_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted. Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves. This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.
question_en: Which of the following causes a skater to turn?
mc_answer1_en: The slight curve on the bottom of the skate’s blade
mc_answer2_en: The dual edges along the skate’s blade
mc_answer3_en: The skater’s overall skill level
mc_answer4_en: The quality of the ice

flores_passage_en: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family. Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield. Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following practices is not consistent with subsistence-oriented agriculture?
mc_answer1_en: Focusing on a yield that meets the needs of the farmer’s family
mc_answer2_en: Producing food to sell to others
mc_answer3_en: Focusing on high yield as opposed to advanced techniques
mc_answer4_en: Sourcing seeds local to the farmer’s area

length_matched_passage: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god. People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals. Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter. Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples. The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.

flores_passage_en: "The ""up bow"" mark looks like a V and the ""down bow mark"" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side. Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow. An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive. flores_passage_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus. According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded. The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born. Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

mc_answer1_en: The Ephesians
mc_answer2_en: Alexander the Great
mc_answer3_en: Strabo
mc_answer4_en: Artemis

flores_passage_en: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes). This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you. If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off. Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.

flores_passage_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others. That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire. Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions. For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car. He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

mc_answer1_en: Eliminate uncertainty behind physical actions
mc_answer2_en: Predict desires
mc_answer3_en: View other humans without judgement
mc_answer4_en: Read the minds of others

It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean. With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as ""Hawaii down under"". There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

flores_passage_en: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar. Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there. Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible. As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally. Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.

mc_answer1_en: Try to get out of the current by aiming in another direction, then swim back to shore normally

mc_answer3_en: Swim in the opposite direction
mc_answer4_en: Swim beneath the surface

flores_passage_en: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era. It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats. The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height. The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2. Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
question_en: Which of the following does not describe the 35mm photography format?
mc_answer1_en: It's still in production
mc_answer2_en: It was adopted by digital camera formats
mc_answer3_en: It has a different aspect ratio than many common formats
mc_answer4_en: It's the most common format in the world

flores_passage_en: "The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today. Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh. The Giza Plateau, or ""Giza Necropolis"" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx. The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members."

flores_passage_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution. The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information. The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong. This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures. People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

flores_passage_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged. In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner. The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked. The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

flores_passage_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances. Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles. Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds. They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow. Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

mc_answer1_en: The formation of Medical Corps
mc_answer2_en: The Empire’s aggressive military policy
mc_answer3_en: The formation of learning hospitals
mc_answer4_en: The Emperor’s recruitment of doctors

flores_passage_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots. Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous. These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves. A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk. Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following would a Triceratops be most likely to eat?
mc_answer1_en: A sloth
mc_answer2_en: A plant with tough branches
mc_answer3_en: A parrot
mc_answer4_en: A plant with poisonous fruit

flores_passage_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries. These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife. The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character. While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries. A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

mc_answer2_en: An onsite gourmet restaurant
mc_answer3_en: Fellow guests that are well-known or recognizable
mc_answer4_en: Recently refurbished rooms with modern upgrades

flores_passage_en: "Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families. The ""typical"" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home. There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of ""going to Disney World"". Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets. While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable."
question_en: Which of the following statements about Walt Disney World is not true?
mc_answer1_en: Park-hopper tickets are transferable to other travelers
mc_answer2_en: There is on-site lodging available
mc_answer3_en: There are buses available to transport travelers from the airpot to the property
mc_answer4_en: Multi-day tickets can often be found on auction websites

flores_passage_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena. Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service. CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

flores_passage_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins. It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes. Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail. That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly. There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.
question_en: Which of the following is most likely to cause danger for climbers throughout the steeper portions of the mountain?
mc_answer1_en: Wet conditions
mc_answer2_en: Stone steps

flores_passage_en: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe. Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture. When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture. When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt. People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.

mc_answer2_en: Travelers who adjusted quickly while living abroad
mc_answer3_en: Travelers that are still in the honeymoon phase

flores_passage: প্ৰৱেশৰ শ্বক (re-entry shock) সংস্কৃতিৰ শ্বক (culture shock) ৰ তুলনাত সোনকালে আৰম্ভ হয় (হানিমুনৰ পৰ্যায় কম থাকে), দীৰ্ঘস্থায়ী হয়, আৰু অধিক তীব্ৰ হ'ব পাৰে। নতুন সংস্কৃতিৰ সৈতে খাপ খোৱা সহজ সময় থকা ভ্ৰমণকাৰীসকলে কেতিয়াবা তেওঁলোকৰ দেশীয় সংস্কৃতিৰ সৈতে খাপ খোৱাত বিশেষভাৱে কঠিন সময় পায়। বিদেশত বাস কৰাৰ পিছত ঘৰলৈ উভতি অহাৰ সময়ত, আপুনি নতুন সংস্কৃতিৰ সৈতে খাপ খাইছে আৰু আপোনাৰ ঘৰুৱা সংস্কৃতিৰ পৰা আপোনাৰ কিছুমান অভ্যাস হেৰুৱাইছে। যেতিয়া আপুনি প্ৰথমতে বিদেশলৈ গৈছিল, মানুহে সম্ভৱতঃ ধৈৰ্য্য আৰু বুজাবুজি আছিল, জানিছিল যে এখন নতুন দেশত ভ্ৰমণকাৰীসকলে খাপ খোৱাৰ প্ৰয়োজন আছে। মানুহে অনুমান নকৰিব পাৰে যে ঘৰলৈ উভতি অহা ভ্ৰমণকাৰীসকলৰ বাবেও ধৈৰ্য্য আৰু বুজাবুজিৰ প্ৰয়োজন।

flores_passage_en: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century. Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day. Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top. This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons. Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.

flores_passage_en: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain. If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate. Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise. Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.

flores_passage: এই প্ৰতিবাদৰ আয়োজকসকলে কয় যে জাৰ্মানীৰ বাৰ্লিন, ক'লন, হামবুৰ্গ আৰু হানোভাৰ আদি চহৰত প্ৰায় ১০০,০০০ লোক উপস্থিত হয়। বাৰ্লিনত আৰক্ষীয়ে ৬,৫০০ প্ৰতিবাদকাৰীৰ অনুমান কৰে। পেৰিছ, বুলগেৰিয়াৰ ছোফিয়া, লিথুৱানৰ ভিল্নিয়ুছ, মাল্টাৰ ভেল্টেটা, এষ্টোনিয়াৰ টালিন আৰু স্কটলেণ্ডৰ এডিনবাৰ্গ আৰু গ্লাছগোতো প্ৰতিবাদ হয়। লণ্ডনত প্ৰায় ২০০ জন লোকে কিছুমান প্ৰধান কপিৰাইট হোল্ডাৰৰ কাৰ্যালয়ৰ বাহিৰত প্ৰতিবাদ কৰে। যোৱা মাহত, পোলেণ্ডত বৃহৎ প্ৰতিবাদ হৈছিল যেতিয়া সেই দেশে এচিটিএত স্বাক্ষৰ কৰিছিল, যাৰ ফলত পোলেণ্ড চৰকাৰে এই চুক্তিখন বৰ্তমানৰ বাবে অনুমোদন নকৰাৰ সিদ্ধান্ত লয়। লেটভিয়া আৰু শ্লোভাকিয়াই এচিটিএত যোগদানৰ প্ৰক্ৰিয়া বিলম্বিত কৰিছে।

Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland. In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices. Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now. Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

flores_passage_en: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda. In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre. While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province. The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa. You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
question_en: Which of the following would not be a good tip for a tourist in Goma?
mc_answer1_en: The fights in North Kivu are entertaining
mc_answer2_en: It’s a good place for affordable Mountain Gorilla Tracking
mc_answer3_en: Motorcycle taxis are a good way to get around
mc_answer4_en: The base of the Nyiragongo volcano is located in the city
flores_passage: গ'মা হৈছে কঙ্গো গণতান্ত্ৰিক প্ৰজাতন্ত্ৰৰ এটা পৰ্যটন নগৰ। ২০০২ চনত গ'মা নাইৰাগংগো আগ্নেয়গিৰিৰ গৰাখহনীয়াৰ দ্বাৰা ধ্বংস কৰা হয়। এই আগ্নেয়গিৰিয়ে নগৰখনৰ অধিকাংশ ৰাস্তা-ঘাট, বিশেষকৈ নগৰ কেন্দ্ৰ বুৰাই পেলায়। যদিও গ'মা যথেষ্ট সুৰক্ষিত, গ'মাৰ বাহিৰৰ যিকোনো ভ্ৰমণ উত্তৰ কিভু প্ৰদেশত অব্যাহত থকা যুদ্ধৰ স্থিতি বুজিবলৈ গৱেষণা কৰা উচিত। এই চহৰখন আফ্ৰিকাৰ সুলভ মাউণ্টেন গৰিলা ট্ৰেকিংৰ সৈতে নাইৰাগংগো আগ্নেয়গিৰি আৰোহণৰ বাবেও আধাৰ। আপুনি গ'মাৰ চাৰিওফালে যাবলৈ বডা-বডা (মটৰচাইকেল টেক্সি) ব্যৱহাৰ কৰিব পাৰে। সাধাৰণ (স্থানীয়) দাম হ'ল সংক্ষিপ্ত যাত্ৰাৰ বাবে ~৫০০ কঙ্গো ফ্ৰাংক।

flores_passage_en: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you). However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class! Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B. Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following is the most probable way to save money on business or first class airfare?
mc_answer1_en: Expensing it through your company
mc_answer2_en: Booking first class instead of business
mc_answer3_en: Booking a non-direct first class flight
mc_answer4_en: Finding a discount

flores_passage_en: "The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect. They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income. In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day. The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as ""a trap"" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself."
question_en: In Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s opinion, what should the country of Iran free itself from?
mc_answer1_en: Financial restrictions
mc_answer2_en: The Islamic revolution
mc_answer3_en: Foreign income
mc_answer4_en: A dependency on oil

flores_passage_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit. Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification. A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers. Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay. He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.
question_en: What is offered to travelers through hospitality exchange networks?
mc_answer1_en: Accommodations with local hosts
mc_answer2_en: Cheap flights

flores_passage_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska. A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9. The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons). As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank. Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

mc_answer1_en: There was thermal expansion inside the tanks
mc_answer2_en: There was a power failure after a system test
mc_answer3_en: The tanks were at full capacity
mc_answer4_en: The secondary containment area could not hold enough barrels

flores_passage_en: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed. According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals! No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack. Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space. In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
question_en: Which of the following is not mentioned in the passage as a possible cause of wildlife attacks?
mc_answer1_en: Strong smells
mc_answer2_en: Failure to maintain distance
mc_answer3_en: Feeding the wildlife
mc_answer4_en: Animals that are unfamiliar with humans

flores_passage_en: "After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap. Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as ""Dunlap broadsides"". The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8. flores_passage_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University). In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals. In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis. Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI. flores_passage_en: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island. In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations. In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885. In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.

flores_passage: ১৬২৪ চনত ডাচ ইষ্ট ইণ্ডিয়া কোম্পানীয়ে দক্ষিণ-পশ্চিম টাইৱানত এটা ঘাটি স্থাপন কৰে, আদিবাসী শস্য উৎপাদনৰ অনুশীলনত এক পৰিৱৰ্তন আৰম্ভ কৰে আৰু চীনা শ্ৰমিকক ইয়াৰ চাউল আৰু সুৰাৰ খেতিপথাৰত কাম কৰিবলৈ নিয়োগ কৰে। ১৬৮৩ চনত, কিং ৰাজবংশী (১৬৪৪-১৯১২) বাহিনীয়ে টাইৱানৰ পশ্চিম আৰু উত্তৰ উপকূলীয় অঞ্চলসমূহৰ নিয়ন্ত্ৰণ কৰে আৰু ১৮৮৫ চনত টাইৱানক কিং সাম্ৰাজ্যৰ এখন প্ৰদেশ হিচাপে ঘোষণা কৰে। ১৮৯৫ চনত, প্ৰথম চীন-জাপান যুদ্ধত পৰাজয়ৰ পিছত (১৮৯৪-১৮৯৫), কিং চৰকাৰে ছিমোনোচেকিৰ সন্ধি স্বাক্ষৰ কৰে, যাৰ দ্বাৰা ই টাইৱানৰ ওপৰত জাপানক সাৰ্বভৌমত্ব প্ৰদান কৰে, যি দ্বীপটো ১৯৪৫ চনলৈকে শাসন কৰে।

In a statement, Bieber said ""[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."" flores_passage_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist. In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance. Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas. For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course. Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

flores_passage_en: "Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources. Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death. The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked. In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids. All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their ""protein problem"" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today."
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following problems is not caused by a lack of essential amino acids?
mc_answer1_en: Digestion issues
mc_answer2_en: Malnutrition
mc_answer3_en: Depressed growth
mc_answer4_en: Death
flores_passage: "চোৱানাৰ বাহিৰত, মানুহৰ দৰে হজম ব্যৱস্থাৰ সৈতে এটা প্ৰাইমেটৰ বাবে উপলব্ধ উদ্ভিদ সম্পদৰ দ্বাৰা আমিন'-এচিডৰ প্ৰয়োজন পূৰণ কৰা কঠিন। তদুপৰি, এই কামত বিফল হ'লে ইয়াৰ গুৰুতৰ পৰিণতি আছে - বৃদ্ধি চাপ, পুষ্টিহীনতা আৰু শেষত মৃত্যু। আটাইতকৈ সহজলভ্য উদ্ভিদৰ সম্পদৰ ভিতৰত পাতা আৰু পতংগজাত শস্যত পোৱা প্ৰোটিনবোৰ হ'ল হ'ব, কিন্তু এইবোৰ আমাৰ দৰে মূল প্ৰাণীবিলাকৰ বাবে ৰন্ধা নোহোৱালৈকে হজম কৰা কঠিন। ইয়াৰ বিপৰীতে, প্ৰাণী খাদ্য (মৃগ, মাখি, ডিম) কেৱল সহজে হজম নহয়, কিন্তু ই সকলো প্ৰয়োজনীয় এমিন' এচিড থকা প্ৰোটিনৰ উচ্চ পৰিমাণ প্ৰদান কৰে। সকলো কথা বিবেচনা কৰি, আমি আচৰিত হব নালাগে যদি আমাৰ পৰম্পৰাগতসকলে তেওঁলোকৰ 'প্ৰোটিন সমস্যা' কিছুমান সমাধান কৰিছিল, যি আজি ছাওভানাৰ চিম্পিঞ্জে কৰে"।

flores_passage_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah. The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky. The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute. Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module. “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

flores_passage_en: "One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment. Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away. Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own. When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans."

flores_passage_en: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before. This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before. The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before. Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population. Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species. We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.

mc_answer2_en: It’s a crucial aspect of the evolution process
mc_answer3_en: It refers to the formation of a new species
mc_answer4_en: It’s occurrence is inevitable
flores_passage: যেতিয়া জীৱৰ এটা সৰু গোট (এটা সৰু জনগোষ্ঠী) মূল জনগোষ্ঠীৰ পৰা পৃথক হয় (যেনে যদি তেওঁলোকে পৰ্বত শৃংগ বা নদীৰ ওপৰেৰে যায়, বা যদি তেওঁলোকে এটা নতুন দ্বীপলৈ যায় যাতে তেওঁলোকে সহজে ঘূৰি যাব নোৱাৰে) তেওঁলোকে প্ৰায়ে পূৰ্বতকৈ পৃথক পৰিৱেশত নিজকে বিচাৰি পাব। এই নতুন পৰিৱেশত বিভিন্ন সম্পদ আৰু বিভিন্ন প্ৰতিদ্বন্দ্বী আছে, গতিকে নতুন জনগোষ্ঠীটোক পূৰ্বতকৈ শক্তিশালী প্ৰতিদ্বন্দ্বী হ'বলৈ বিভিন্ন বৈশিষ্ট্য বা অভিযোজনৰ প্ৰয়োজন হ'ব। মূল জনগোষ্ঠীটো একেবাৰে সলনি হোৱা নাই, তেওঁলোকক এতিয়াও পূৰ্বৰ দৰেই একেই অভিযোজনৰ প্ৰয়োজন। সময়ৰ লগে লগে, যেতিয়া নতুন জনগোষ্ঠীয়ে তেওঁলোকৰ নতুন পৰিৱেশত খাপ খাবলৈ আৰম্ভ কৰে, তেওঁলোকে আন জনগোষ্ঠীৰ দৰে কমকৈ দেখিবলৈ আৰম্ভ কৰে। অৱশেষত, হাজাৰ বা আনকি মিলিয়ন বছৰৰ পিছত, দুয়োটা জনগোষ্ঠীয়ে ইমান পৃথক দেখিবলৈ আৰম্ভ কৰে যে তেওঁলোকক একে প্ৰজাতি বুলি অভিহিত কৰিব নোৱাৰি। আমি এই প্ৰক্ৰিয়াটোক প্ৰজাতিগতকৰণ বুলি কওঁ, যাৰ অৰ্থ হৈছে নতুন প্ৰজাতিৰ সৃষ্টি। ই এক গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ, অনিবাৰনীয় পৰিণতি আৰু বিৱৰ্তনৰ এক অতি গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ অংশ।

flores_passage_en: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed. Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
question_en: According to the passage, how does selection affect the relationship between the two pools of genetic variation?
mc_answer1_en: Selection removes variation from the pool of expressed variation, which indirectly alters the balance between hidden and expressed pools over generations.
mc_answer2_en: Selection shuffles variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
mc_answer3_en: Selection eliminates mutation, stopping the creation of new genetic variation entirely.
mc_answer4_en: Selection adds new genetic variation to the hidden pool, preventing it from being expressed.

flores_passage_en: "Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau. These plateaus are often referred to as ""vidde"" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse. In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called ""hei"" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather."
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement accurately describes the regional naming variations of the plateaus in Norway?
mc_answer1_en: Plateaus in Rogaland and Agder are typically called 'vidde,' while those elsewhere are called 'hei.'
mc_answer2_en: The plateaus are referred to as 'vidde' in general, but in Rogaland and Agder, they are usually called 'hei.'
mc_answer3_en: All Norwegian plateaus are called 'hei,' but in Rogaland and Agder, they are specifically referred to as 'vidde.'
mc_answer4_en: The term 'vidde' is used specifically for treeless moorlands covered in heather across all regions.
flores_passage: "নৰ্ৱেৰ বাবে প্ৰচলিত হ'ল তীব্ৰ ফিজৰ্ড আৰু উপত্যকা যি হঠাতে উচ্চ, কম-বেছি সমান মালভূমিৰ পথ দিয়ে। এই মালভূমিসমূহক প্ৰায়ে ""vidde"" বুলি কোৱা হয় যাৰ অৰ্থ হৈছে এক বিস্তৃত, খোলা গছবিহীন স্থান, এক সীমাহীন বিস্তৃতি। ৰ'গলেণ্ড আৰু আগডাৰত ইয়াক সাধাৰণতে ""হে"" বুলি কোৱা হয় যাৰ অৰ্থ হ'ল এটি গছবিহীন ময়ূৰ ভূমি প্ৰায়ে হিডাৰৰে আচ্ছাদিত। "

He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means ""the correct sounds for the instruction of the people""."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements correctly identifies the original name of the Hangeul alphabet and the dynasty during which it was created?
mc_answer1_en: The Hangeul alphabet was originally named Hunmin Jeongeum and was created during the Ming Dynasty.
mc_answer2_en: The Hangeul alphabet was originally named Hunmin Jeongeum and was created during the reign of King Sejong's grandson.
mc_answer3_en: The Hangeul alphabet was originally named Hunmin Jeongeum and was created during the Joseon Dynasty.
mc_answer4_en: The Hangeul alphabet was originally named the correct sounds for the instruction of the people and was created during the Joseon Dynasty.

flores_passage_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate. However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars. It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.
question_en: According to the passage, what is the relationship between forming a group of four to six people and the pricing of tours?
mc_answer1_en: Forming a group guarantees a lower price per person, but tourists are often shuffled into groups by the tour company.
mc_answer2_en: Forming a group has no impact on the price per person, and tourists are shuffled to fill cars.
mc_answer3_en: Forming a group ensures a lower price per person, and tourists are always grouped by their own choice.
mc_answer4_en: Forming a group increases the price per person, and tourists are shuffled to avoid group discounts.

flores_passage_en: "Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti. While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint. However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and ""legal"" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags."

mc_answer1_en: It can resemble legitimate artworks.
mc_answer2_en: It is often mistaken for simple vandalism.
mc_answer3_en: It is always created using spray paint.
mc_answer4_en: It is restricted to public property.

flores_passage_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole. It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies. These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why the South Pole Traverse cannot take a direct route to the Pole?
mc_answer1_en: The compacted snow surface requires the trail to avoid areas filled with crevasses at all costs.
mc_answer2_en: The flags marking the trail are only placed along the plateau, not near the Ross Sea.
mc_answer3_en: The distance of 1600 km forces the trail to take a longer path to conserve fuel for the sleds.
mc_answer4_en: The trail must navigate around the Transantarctic Mountains due to the limited maneuverability of the specialized tractors.

flores_passage_en: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education. As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times. Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement best explains why modern research telescopes are typically situated in remote areas rather than in cities or campuses?
mc_answer1_en: Modern telescopes are smaller and more portable than pre-modern observatories, allowing them to be placed in remote locations without inconvenience.
mc_answer2_en: Pre-modern observatories were designed to be easily accessible, while modern ones prioritize ease of maintenance over observation quality.
mc_answer3_en: Light pollution was a significant concern for pre-modern observatories, making urban locations less desirable for modern telescopes.
mc_answer4_en: Modern telescopes require favorable atmospheric conditions that are often compromised by light pollution in urban areas.
flores_passage: প্ৰাক-আধুনিক পৰ্যবেক্ষণাগাৰবোৰ সাধাৰণতে আজি অপ্ৰচলিত হৈ পৰিছে, আৰু সংগ্ৰহালয় বা শিক্ষাৰ স্থান হিচাপে ৰৈছে। যিহেতু আলোক প্ৰদূষণ তেওঁলোকৰ উজ্জ্বল দিনত আজিৰ দৰে এক ধৰণৰ সমস্যা নাছিল, সেইবোৰ সাধাৰণতে চহৰ বা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় চৌহদত অৱস্থিত, আধুনিক সময়ত নিৰ্মিত তুলনাত সহজলভ্য। বেছিভাগ আধুনিক গৱেষণা দূৰবীণ হৈছে অনুকূল বায়ুমণ্ডলীয় পৰিস্থিতিৰ সৈতে দুৰ্গম অঞ্চলৰ বিশাল সুবিধা।

flores_passage_en: "Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany. As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment."

flores_passage_en: "Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant. While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is ""bien élevé"" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier. Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies."

mc_answer1_en: Ignoring their abrupt exteriors completely
mc_answer2_en: Avoiding direct contact to prevent misunderstandings
mc_answer3_en: Embracing the stereotype of being egocentric in return
mc_answer4_en: Displaying basic courtesies and acting well-mannered
flores_passage: "প্যাৰিছবাসী স্বাৰ্থপৰ, অশালীন আৰু অহংকাৰী হোৱাৰ বাবে খ্যাতি লাভ কৰিছে। যদিও এইটো প্ৰায়ে কেৱল এক ভুল বৰ্ণনা হয়, তথাপিও প্যাৰিছত সহ্য কৰাৰ সৰ্বশ্ৰেষ্ঠ উপায় হ'ল আপোনাৰ সৰ্বশ্ৰেষ্ঠ আচৰণত থকা, এজনৰ দৰে আচৰণ কৰা যি ""bien élevé"" (ভালভাৱে উত্থাপিত) । ই যথেষ্ট সহজ কৰি তুলিব। যদি আপুনি কিছুমান মৌলিক সৌজন্যতা প্ৰদৰ্শন কৰে তেন্তে প্যাৰিছীয়ানৰ হঠকাৰী বহিৰ্ভাগ দ্ৰুতভাৱে বাষ্পীভূত হ'ব। "

flores_passage_en: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon. This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock. As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.

mc_answer1_en: Because the sun does not rise above the horizon, resulting in prolonged darkness.
mc_answer2_en: Because the stars are more visible when the sun is below the horizon.
mc_answer3_en: Because light pollution is absent in these regions due to sparse population.
mc_answer4_en: Because the Aurora borealis only appears when the sky is completely black for 24 hours.

flores_passage_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches. The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest. Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best explains why an avalanche might be triggered after a period of stable snow conditions?
mc_answer1_en: Natural events like wind are the sole cause of avalanches, and human presence cannot act as a trigger.
mc_answer2_en: Avalanches only occur when the sun directly melts the snow, regardless of slope stability or volume.
mc_answer3_en: Sticky snow prevents any movement unless a large snowfall event occurs, making human activity irrelevant.
mc_answer4_en: The excess snow volume exceeds the slope's holding capacity, requiring a trigger like sunlight or human activity to initiate movement.

flores_passage_en: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system. Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece. There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements accurately reflects the presence of flush toilets in ancient civilizations?
mc_answer1_en: Toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia, and China were part of public bath houses where men and women were together.
mc_answer2_en: Remains of sewage systems have been found only in the houses of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro.

flores_passage_en: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection. mc_answer1_en: ZMapp was the most effective treatment in the PALM trial, demonstrating superior mortality reduction compared to the three other treatments tested.
mc_answer2_en: ZMapp was excluded from the PALM trial because previous studies proved it was completely ineffective at reducing Ebola mortality.

flores_passage_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees. The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking. The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges. Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
question_en: Based on the passage, what can be inferred about the evolutionary shift in hand specialization among hominids compared to chimpanzees?
mc_answer1_en: Chimpanzees use their hands for bearing weight while humans use theirs for manipulation
mc_answer2_en: Both species use their hands primarily for locomotion
mc_answer3_en: The human foot is longer than the hand due to locomotion needs
mc_answer4_en: Hominids have longer hands than chimpanzees

flores_passage_en: The Mumbai attackers arrived via boat on Novemeber 26, 2008, bringing with them grenades, automatic weapons and hit multiple targets including the crowded Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus railway station and the famous Taj Mahal Hotel. David Headley's scouting and information gathering had helped to enable the operation by the 10 gunmen from the Pakistani militant group Laskhar-e-Taiba. The attack put a huge strain on relations between India and Pakistan.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best describes the sequence of events that led to the strain on India-Pakistan relations?
mc_answer1_en: David Headley gathered intelligence that enabled the Laskhar-e-Taiba gunmen to attack targets like Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus, which subsequently strained India-Pakistan relations.
mc_answer2_en: Relations between India and Pakistan were strained before the attack due to David Headley's scouting, which prompted the attackers to arrive by boat on November 26, 2008.
mc_answer3_en: The attackers used grenades and weapons to hit targets like the Taj Mahal Hotel, which directly caused David Headley to gather intelligence.
mc_answer4_en: The Mumbai attackers arrived via boat on November 26, 2008, which led to David Headley gathering information that enabled the Laskhar-e-Taiba gunmen to hit the Taj Mahal Hotel.
flores_passage: ২০০৮ চনৰ ২৬ নৱেম্বৰত মুম্বাই আক্ৰমণকাৰীসকল নাৱেৰে মুম্বাইত উপস্থিত হয়। তেওঁলোকৰ লগত গ্ৰেণেড, স্বয়ংক্ৰিয় অস্ত্ৰ আৰু বহু সংখ্যক টাৰ্গেট আঘাত কৰে। ইয়াৰ ভিতৰত আছিল জনবহুল ছত্ৰপতি শিৱাজী টাৰ্মিনছ ৰেল ষ্টেচন আৰু বিখ্যাত তাজ মহল হোটেল। ডেভিড হেডলীৰ স্কাউটিং আৰু তথ্য সংগ্ৰহ কৰাই পাকিস্তানী উগ্ৰপন্থী দল লস্খৰ-ই-তৈবাৰ ১০ গৰাকী বন্দুকধাৰীয়ে অভিযান চলোৱাত সহায় কৰিছিল। এই আক্ৰমণে ভাৰত আৰু পাকিস্তানৰ সম্পৰ্কত এক বৃহৎ চাপ সৃষ্টি কৰে।
question: তলৰ কোনটো পংক্তিৰ ভিত্তিত ভাৰত-পাকিস্তানৰ সম্পৰ্কত উত্তেজনাৰ সৃষ্টি কৰা ঘটনাৰ শ্ৰেষ্ঠ বৰ্ণনা পোৱা যায়?
mc_answer1: ডেভিদ হেডলীয়ে চোৰাংচোৱা তথ্য সংগ্ৰহ কৰিছিল যিয়ে লস্কৰ-ই-তৈবাৰ বন্দুকধাৰীক ছত্ৰপতি শিৱাজী টাৰ্মিনাসৰ দৰে লক্ষ্যবস্তুৰ ওপৰত আক্ৰমণ কৰিবলৈ সক্ষম কৰিছিল, যি পৰৱৰ্তী সময়ত ভাৰত-পাকিস্তানৰ সম্পৰ্কক উত্তেজিত কৰিছিল।
mc_answer2: ডেভিড হেডলীৰ স্কাউটিংৰ বাবে ভাৰত আৰু পাকিস্তানৰ মাজৰ সম্পৰ্ক আক্ৰমণৰ পূৰ্বে উত্তেজিত হৈ পৰিছিল, যাৰ বাবে আক্ৰমণকাৰীসকলে ২৬ নৱেম্বৰ, ২০০৮ তাৰিখে নাৱেৰে আহি উপস্থিত হৈছিল।
mc_answer3: আক্ৰমণকাৰীসকলে তাজ মহল হোটেলৰ দৰে লক্ষ্যত আঘাত হানিবলৈ গ্ৰেণেড আৰু অস্ত্ৰ ব্যৱহাৰ কৰিছিল, যাৰ ফলত ডেভিড হেডলীয়ে চোৰাংচোৱা তথ্য সংগ্ৰহ কৰিছিল।

flores_passage_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change. Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same. Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom. It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid. Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
question_en: Based on the passage, how does the molecular structure of water behave when it transitions between physical states?
mc_answer1_en: It becomes more complex in liquid form
mc_answer2_en: It remains identical regardless of state

mc_answer3_en: Natural factors cause the algae to multiply, but the toxins only harm marine life, not humans.

flores_passage_en: "The ""up bow"" mark looks like a V and the ""down bow mark"" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side. Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow. An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive. Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected."

flores_passage_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel. question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why the geographic origin of a selected phone number might impact the cost or experience of someone calling you via VoIP?
mc_answer1_en: A user in Arizona can select a number from Alaska while traveling in Chicken, but callers to that number may incur long-distance charges depending on where the number is registered.
mc_answer2_en: A satellite Internet connection allows users to bypass all local phone company requirements, ensuring free calls to any number selected.

flores_passage_en: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience. If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music. question_en: If an attendee wants to secure a camping spot near the main stages while also ensuring their young children have a suitable environment, what must they consider regarding timing and festival structure?
mc_answer1_en: Wait until after the main stages finish playing to camp, as this is when family areas become available.
mc_answer2_en: Avoid camping on site entirely and stay in nearby hotels to ensure children get rest.
mc_answer3_en: Arrive early to camp near the stages and check if the festival offers family-specific camping areas.
mc_answer4_en: Camp in the central area immediately upon arrival since all music stops at the same time.

flores_passage_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand. Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years. We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past. Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events. You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
question_en: According to the passage, how can a person mark the passing of time themselves without external measurement tools?
mc_answer1_en: By comparing the duration of different events
mc_answer2_en: By observing the repetition of a cyclical event
mc_answer3_en: By understanding how time affects everything we do
mc_answer4_en: By studying religious scholars from thousands of years ago

flores_passage_en: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation. It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude. The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species. Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best describes the relationship between the microclimates in Plitvice Lakes National Park and the variety of species found there?
mc_answer1_en: The heavy forestation with beech, spruce, and fir trees is the only factor influencing the park's biodiversity.
mc_answer2_en: The park's altitude range alone determines the types of rare fauna that can be found there.

mc_answer2_en: It is a region of Moldova that shares the same language and religion as the capital city but has no independent government.
mc_answer3_en: It is an officially recognized province of Moldova that uses the same currency as the rest of the country.
mc_answer4_en: It is a fully sovereign nation that is widely recognized by the United Nations and most member states.
flores_passage: মোল্ডোভিয়াৰ ৰাজধানী হৈছে চিচিনেউ। স্থানীয় ভাষা হৈছে ৰোমানিয়ান, কিন্তু ৰাছিয়ান বহুলভাৱে ব্যৱহৃত হয়। মোল্ডোভিয়া হৈছে এক বহু জাতিগত প্ৰজাতন্ত্ৰ যি জাতিগত সংঘাতত ভুগিছে। ১৯৯৪ চনত, এই সংঘাতৰ ফলত পূব মোল্ডোভিয়াৰ স্ব-ঘোষিত ট্ৰান্সনিষ্ট্ৰিয়া প্ৰজাতন্ত্ৰৰ সৃষ্টি হয়, যাৰ নিজস্ব চৰকাৰ আৰু মুদ্ৰা আছে কিন্তু কোনো ৰাষ্ট্ৰসংঘৰ সদস্য দেশে ইয়াক স্বীকৃতি দিয়া নাই। মোল্ডোভিয়াৰ এই দুটা অংশৰ মাজত ৰাজনৈতিক আলোচনাৰ বিফলতা সত্ত্বেও অৰ্থনৈতিক সম্পৰ্ক পুনৰ স্থাপন কৰা হৈছে। মোল্ডোভিয়াৰ প্ৰধান ধৰ্ম হৈছে অৰ্থাডক্স খ্ৰীষ্টান।

flores_passage_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings. An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites. A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person. Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases. These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following statements correctly links the definition of a contagious disease with vaccination requirements for travelers?
mc_answer1_en: A contagious disease can be transmitted by proximity to an infected person, and vaccination may be required depending on the countries visited.
mc_answer2_en: Contagious diseases are always infectious, and all travelers must be vaccinated for contagious diseases before entering any country.
mc_answer3_en: An infectious disease is caused by a pathogen, and vaccination is only required for diseases that are not contagious.
mc_answer4_en: Vaccination requirements are based solely on the type of pathogen causing the disease, regardless of transmission method.
flores_passage: সংক্ৰামক ৰোগ (ইংৰাজীঃ Infectious disease) হ'ল কোনো ৰোগৰ দ্বাৰা সংক্ৰমিত হোৱা ৰোগ। সংক্ৰামক ৰোগ (ইংৰাজীঃ Infectious disease) হৈছে ভাইৰাছ, বেক্টেৰিয়া, ফাংগাছ বা অন্যান্য পৰজীৱী আদিৰ দ্বাৰা সংক্ৰমিত হোৱা ৰোগ। সংক্ৰামক ৰোগ (ইংৰাজীঃ Contagious disease) হ'ল এজন সংক্ৰমিত ব্যক্তিৰ আশে-পাশে থাকি সহজে সংক্ৰমিত হোৱা ৰোগ। বহুতো চৰকাৰে তেওঁলোকৰ দেশলৈ প্ৰৱেশ কৰা বা প্ৰস্থান কৰা লোকক বিভিন্ন ৰোগৰ বাবে টিকাকৰণ কৰিব লাগে। এই প্ৰয়োজনীয়তা প্ৰায়ে ভ্ৰমণকাৰীজনে ভ্ৰমণ কৰা বা ভ্ৰমণ কৰিব বিচৰা দেশসমূহৰ ওপৰত নিৰ্ভৰ কৰিব পাৰে।

mc_answer4: প্ৰতিষেধক প্ৰদানৰ প্ৰয়োজনীয়তা কেৱল ৰোগ সৃষ্টিকাৰী বীজাণুৰ প্ৰকাৰৰ ওপৰত নিৰ্ভৰ কৰে, সংক্ৰমণৰ পদ্ধতিৰ ওপৰত নিৰ্ভৰ নকৰাকৈ।

flores_passage_en: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures. On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt. During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time. Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows. On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
question_en: If a driver plans to travel through a mountain pass in a country where icy conditions are common year-round, what is the most critical safety consideration they must account for, based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: They must ensure that visibility is never compromised by condensation on vehicle windows.
mc_answer2_en: They should avoid driving entirely if temperatures drop below freezing to prevent ice formation.
mc_answer3_en: They can drive at normal speeds because traffic remains mostly uninterrupted due to familiarity with the conditions.
mc_answer4_en: They should expect that snowfall can accumulate quickly enough to immobilize the vehicle even in regions accustomed to winter weather.
flores_passage: উচ্চ অক্ষাংশত বা পাৰ্বত্য অঞ্চলত গাড়ী চলাব বিচৰা যিকোনো ব্যক্তিয়ে বৰফ, হিম বা হিমশীতল তাপমাত্ৰাৰ সম্ভাৱনা বিবেচনা কৰা উচিত। হিমশীতল আৰু তুষাৰযুক্ত পথসমূহত, ঘর্ষণ কম আৰু আপুনি খালী এচফাল্টত থকাৰ দৰে গাড়ী চলাব নোৱাৰে। তুষাৰপাতৰ সময়ত, আপোনাক আৱদ্ধ কৰিবলৈ পৰ্যাপ্ত বৰফ খুব কম সময়ৰ ভিতৰতে পৰিব পাৰে। দৃশ্যমানতাও বৰফৰ পৰা বা উৰি যোৱা বা বাহনখনৰ উইন্ডোত ঘনীভূত বা বৰফৰ দ্বাৰা সীমাবদ্ধ হ'ব পাৰে। অন্যহাতে, বহু দেশত হিমশীতল আৰু তুষাৰযুক্ত পৰিস্থিতি স্বাভাৱিক, আৰু যান-বাহন গোটেই বছৰ জুৰি অবিৰামভাৱে চলি থাকে।
question: যদি এজন ড্ৰাইভাৰে এটা পাহাৰীয়া পথৰ মাজেৰে যাত্ৰা কৰাৰ পৰিকল্পনা কৰে য'ত গোটেই বছৰ জুৰি বৰফৰ পৰিৱেশ প্ৰচলিত হৈ থাকে, তেন্তে সেই পথটোৰ ওপৰত ভিত্তি কৰি তেওঁ আটাইতকৈ গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ সুৰক্ষা বিবেচনা কি হ'ব লাগে?
mc_answer1: তেওঁলোকে নিশ্চিত কৰিব লাগিব যে যান-বাহনৰ উইণ্ড'জত ঘনীভৱনৰ ফলত দৃশ্যমানতা কেতিয়াও হ্ৰাস নহয়।
mc_answer2: বৰফ গঠনৰ প্ৰতিৰোধ কৰিবলৈ যদি তাপমাত্ৰা হিমশীতলৰ তললৈ নামি আহে তেন্তে তেওঁলোকে সম্পূৰ্ণৰূপে গাড়ী চলোৱা এৰাই চলিব লাগে।
mc_answer3: তেওঁলোকে স্বাভাৱিক গতিত গাড়ী চলাব পাৰে কাৰণ পৰিস্থিতিৰ সৈতে পৰিচিত হোৱাৰ বাবে যান-বাহন চলাচল প্ৰায় নিৰৱচ্ছিন্ন হৈ থাকে।
mc_answer4: তেওঁলোকে আশা কৰা উচিত যে তুষাৰপাত যথেষ্ট দ্ৰুততাৰে জমা হ'ব পাৰে যাতে শীতৰ বতৰত অভ্যস্ত অঞ্চলসমূহতো বাহনখন স্থবিৰ হৈ পৰে।

flores_passage_en: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population. There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike. Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis. Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best explains why visitors are instructed to avoid making jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis?
mc_answer1_en: Because the passage explicitly states that visitors must not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
mc_answer2_en: Because the site serves as both a mass grave and a place of deep meaning for many people worldwide.

flores_passage_en: "Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as ""King Tut"" or ""The Boy King"", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times. Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists. However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. flores_passage_en: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes). This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you. If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off. Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
question_en: After purposefully awakening during the normal sleep period, which of these would interfere with the sleep interruption process?
mc_answer1_en: Reading for an hour and half before falling back to sleep
mc_answer2_en: Using the bathroom and going right back to bed
mc_answer3_en: Shutting off the alarm on your nightstand and falling back to sleep twenty minutes later
mc_answer4_en: Waking up to drink water from a bottle on your nightstand

flores_passage_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others. That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire. Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions. For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car. He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
question_en: Based on the passage, under what condition would a person breaking a car window be judged differently than if they were stealing a stranger's car?
mc_answer1_en: If the person had lost their own car keys and was trying to break into their own car
mc_answer2_en: If the person was trying to open a locked door to a public building

flores_passage_en: "The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.
